title: HarnessProfile
description: Typed capability profile and layout bindings for an agent harness.

skills_dir.description: Relative project-local path where skills reside for this harness (e.g. .grok/skills, .agents/skills).

plugins_dir.description: Host-level plugins directory where external or global plugins are installed.

plugin_manifest.description: Relative path to projected harness-native plugin manifest.

skill_order.description: Ordered 3-tier fallback table from pstack need to pstack, user, and builtin skills.

runtime_conventions.description: Host-specific execution constraints, isolation modes, and model spawn fields.

setup.description: Where this host declares its model and reasoning-effort setup surface, and which skill owns the host-specific steps. Absent means no declared setup surface (a GAP for /setup-pstack), never another host's fallback.
